title: Calculate time beyond a booking
prompt: Write extraHours(hours: number, included: number): number. For nonnegative numbers, return the hours beyond the included amount, or 0 when the booking covers everything. A later call starts fresh.
hints: Consider a booking that is larger than the time used.
Decide what to return when all time is covered.
On the other path return only the excess.
feedback: Consider a booking that is larger than the time used.
